description: Architects Registration Board - List of "Chartered Architects" "Architects" and Architectural Licentiates registered in the ARB for the Year 2022
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the registration and renewal of registration for architects ("Chartered Architects", "Architects", and "Architectural Licentiates") for the year 2022/2023. This is a commercial licensing and certification matter administered by the Architects Registration Board under the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects (Amendment) Act, falling under business and professional regulation. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized category better than Commercial.
